acceptance_criteria.criterion: Agent map contains both agent_my_persona (display name) and agent_slug_my_persona (slug) for each persona.

summary: Added agent_slug_* key emission in buildAgentNameMap(): for each persona, a new `agent_slug_<underscored_slug>` key is emitted alongside the existing `agent_<underscored_slug>` display-name key. The slug key's value is the raw slug string (with hyphens preserved), enabling templates to reference personas by slug for task(subagent=...) invocations.

Added three new tests in tests/builders/agent-name-map.test.ts under 'agent_slug_* keys' describe block: (1) verifies slug key resolves to the raw slug string, (2) verifies hyphenated slugs have hyphens preserved in the value while the key uses underscores, (3) verifies display-name and slug keys coexist correctly.
All 284 tests pass. TypeScript type check clean.

comments.note: The slug.replace(/-/g, '_') transform is repeated twice in buildAgentNameMap() — once for the display-name key and once for the slug key. A one-liner extracting the underscored slug to a local variable would remove the duplication, but the function is short enough that it causes no real maintenance concern.
